---
title: "Remove extreme H5Nx temporal/tree outliers"
output: github_document
date: "2025-04-07"
---

## Description
* remove temporal outliers, targeting samples/seqeunces that are outliers in all segments

## v2 changes
* increase cutoff for pendant edge, and make relative to segment width: eg. 6% of 1000 sites = max 60 subs on terminal branch length. 
* increase residuals rtt at 10 stdevs 
* remove seqs from samples where any of the 8 segment sequences fail criteria

# Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Libs
```{r, message=F}
library(Biostrings)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtools)
library(ape)
```

# Input trees from fasttree, rooted using ape-rtt (or can specify tempest)

l.tre<-length(trees.in)

# Filled in dates for incomplete, in decimal date format and tip names

resid.in<-str_replace_all(trees.in, ".tre",".tsv")

fasta.in<-str_replace_all(trees.in, f.in.tre,f.in.fasta) %>% str_replace_all("_rooted.tre","_aligned.fasta")
# file.exists(fasta.in)

f.in.meta<-"../../../data/04_clean-align/2026-01-12_clean_aligns_wg_out/cleaned_meta/"
meta.in<-str_replace_all(trees.in, f.in.tre,f.in.meta) %>%
  str_replace_all("trim_nodup_nuc","merged_cleaned_filt_meta") %>%

# file.exists(meta.in)

# Output

f.out<-paste0(today,"_rem-outliers/")
if(!dir.exists(f.out)){dir.create(f.out)}

#subfolder for aligns, trees, resid, dates

## Read in the trees, data
```{r}
dates.list<-resid<-nuc<-dates<-meta<-trees<-replicate(l.tre, vector())
summ.table$ntip.start<-NA
i=1
for(i in 1:l.tre){
  trees[[i]]<-ape::read.tree(trees.in[i]) 
  meta[[i]]<-read.csv(file=meta.in[i],header=T)
  dates[[i]]<-read.csv(dates.in[i],sep=",",header=T)
  resid[[i]]<-read.table(file=resid.in[i] ,sep="\t",header=T)
  nuc[[i]]<-Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(fasta.in[i]) ## change

  #Join the decdates on by seq_new to meta 
  colnames(resid[[i]])[1]<-"seq_new"
  colnames(dates[[i]])<-c("seq_new","dec.date") #the actual decdate used in the fit for root
  #check full match of resid (meta still includes dups and filtered out in clean_align)
  all (resid[[i]]$seq_new %in% meta[[i]]$seq_new) # but resid should all be repped in meta
  
  resid[[i]]<-left_join(resid[[i]], dates[[i]], by="seq_new")
  resid[[i]]<-left_join(resid[[i]], meta[[i]], by="seq_new")
  
  #log data
  summ.table$ntip.start[i]<-Ntip(trees[[i]])
  summ.table$width[i]<-width(nuc[[i]][1])
}
```

## Root-to-tip regression before removals
```{r}
#prepare to pull model fits into summary table
summ.table$modelfit.start<-NA
summ.table$R2.start<-NA

##  plot residuals by segment tree
for (i in 1:l.tre){
  segment<-resid[[i]]$segment[1]

  #root-to-tip regression
  lm<-summary(lm(resid[[i]]$distance ~ resid[[i]]$dec.date))
  slope<-formatC(coef(lm)[[2]],format="e", digits=2)
  slope.n<-coef(lm)[[2]] #numeric
  int<-coef(lm)[[1]]
  eq<-paste("y = ",slope," x + ",signif(int,digits=3),sep="")
  R2<-signif(lm$adj.r.squared,digits = 3)
  
  #add these to the table
  summ.table$modelfit.start[i]<-eq
  summ.table$R2.start[i]<-R2    
  
  #set positions
  min.x<-min(resid[[i]]$date)
  max.y<-max(resid[[i]]$distance)
  
  #overlay line on scatter plot, colored by residual
  ggplot(resid[[i]])+
    geom_point(aes(x=date,y=distance, color=abs(residual)))+
    scale_color_continuous(type = "viridis")+
    labs(x="Year",y="Root-to-tip distance",color="Abs.value\nresidual",title=segment)+
    theme_bw()+
    geom_abline(slope=slope.n,intercept = int,color="black")+
    annotate("text",label=paste("Adj.R^2=",R2,"\n",eq,sep=""),
             x=min.x,y=max.y*0.98,vjust=1, hjust=0,color="black",size=3)
  ggsave(paste(fig.out,"/TemporalSignalResidInclOutlier_",segment,".png",sep=""),
         height=3,width=4,units="in")
}
```

## Distribution of residuals
```{r}
n.dev<-10 #how many stdevs away allowable? (max)

#Prepare to extract this into summary table
summ.table$cutoff<-NA_real_
summ.table$Ntip.residual.out<-NA_real_

# Store per-segment outliers (long table)
outlier_list<-vector("list", length = l.tre)

## First: detect outliers per segment, plot, and record
for (i in 1:l.tre){
  segment<-resid[[i]]$segment[1]
  cutoff<-n.dev*sd(resid[[i]]$residual,na.rm=T) 
  out_idx<-which(abs(resid[[i]]$residual) > cutoff)

  #calculate n cutoff (on negative or positive side)
  n.cutoff<-length(out_idx)
  
  # Save to summary table
  summ.table$cutoff[i]<-cutoff
  summ.table$Ntip.residual.out[i]<-n.cutoff
  
  #density plot, colored by residual
  min.x<-cutoff
  max.y<-.95  
  ggplot(resid[[i]])+
    geom_density(aes(x=(residual), y=..scaled..))+
    labs(x="Residual",y="Scaled density", title=segment)+
    theme_bw()+
    geom_vline(xintercept=cutoff,color="red",linetype=2)+
    geom_vline(xintercept=cutoff,color="red",linetype=2)+
    geom_vline(xintercept=-cutoff,color="red",linetype=2)+
    annotate("text",label=paste("cutoff = ",signif(cutoff,digits=3),"\n", "n excluded = ",n.cutoff,sep=""),
             x=min.x,y=max.y*0.98,hjust=0,color="black",size=3)
  ggsave(paste(fig.out,"/densityResiduals_N-outliers_",segment,".png",sep=""),height=3,width=4,units="in")
  
  # Record outliers for this segment
  if (n.cutoff > 0) {
    outlier_list[[i]]<-resid[[i]] %>%
      slice(out_idx) %>%
      transmute(
        segment = .data$segment,
        seq_new = .data$seq_new,
        residual = .data$residual,
        cutoff = cutoff
      )
  } else {
    outlier_list[[i]]<-resid[[i]][0, c("segment", "seq_new", "residual")] %>%
      mutate(cutoff = cutoff)
  }

  # Log segment outliers (segment-specific list)
  if (n.cutoff > 0) {
    cat(paste0(
        "\nSegment ", segment,
        " temporal outliers flagged (segment-specific), cutoff=",
        signif(cutoff, 3), ": ",
        paste(resid[[i]]$seq_new[out_idx], collapse = ", ")
      ),
      file = text.out, sep = "\n", append = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    cat(
      paste0("\nSegment ", segment, " temporal outliers flagged: none (cutoff=", signif(cutoff, 3), ")"),
      file = text.out, sep = "\n", append = TRUE
    )
  }
}

# Combine long table of all flagged seq_new across segments
outlier_tbl<-bind_rows(outlier_list)

#segment-level removal set
bad.seqs.seg<-outlier_tbl %>%
  distinct(seq_new) %>%
  pull(seq_new)

resid.all<-bind_rows(resid) %>% 
  select(seq_new, sample)

bad.samps<-resid.all %>% 
  filter(seq_new %in% bad.seqs.seg) %>% 
  distinct (sample) %>% 
  pull(sample) #4 bad samples, 29 bad seqs within them

#sample-level removal set
bad.seqs<-resid.all %>% 
  filter(sample %in% bad.samps) %>% 
  pull(seq_new)
length(bad.seqs) #32 =4*8

#join the sample on to this
outlier_tbl<-outlier_tbl %>% left_join (resid.all, by="seq_new")

# Log the UNION list
write.csv(outlier_tbl, paste0(f.out2, "outlier_tbl.csv"))

# Apply removal everywhere:
#filter meta, drop tips + filter resid rows by bad.seqs
for (i in seq_len(l.tre)) {
  meta[[i]]<-meta[[i]] %>% filter(!seq_new %in% bad.seqs)
  # Drop tips that are both "bad" and actually present in the tree
  if (!is.null(trees[[i]]) && length(bad.seqs) > 0) {
    tips_present<-intersect(trees[[i]]$tip.label, bad.seqs)
    if (length(tips_present) > 0) {
      trees[[i]]<-ape::drop.tip(phy = trees[[i]], tip = tips_present)
    }
  }

  # Filter resid rows (if any)
  resid[[i]]<-resid[[i]] %>% filter(!seq_new %in% bad.seqs)
}
```

# Exclude further based on pendant edge length (terminal branch leading to tip)
## pendant edge length
```{r}
## calculate the pendant edge length (last branch leading to tip)
pendant.edge <-function(tree, scale=F){
  if(is.rooted(tree)==FALSE)
    warning("A rooted phylogeny is required for meaningful output of this function", call.=FALSE)
  if(scale==TRUE){
    #Scale tree to have unit depth (for ultrametric tree) or scale all branches to unit length (for additive tree)
    if(is.ultrametric(tree)==TRUE)
      tree<- rescaleTree(tree, 1) else
        tree$edge.length<- tree$edge.length/sum(tree$edge.length)
  }
  edge.index<-which(tree$edge[,2] %in% 1:length(tree$tip.label))
  w<- as.data.frame(tree$edge.length[edge.index])
  results<- cbind(tree$tip.label, w)
  names(results)<- c("species", "w")
  results
}
```

## Plot and exclude outliers based on long pendant edge
```{r}
#calculate pendant edges and apply cutoff
# max.muts<-100
#instead of max muts, set muts as a percentage of width (scale with segment size)
max.p.mut<-0.06 # max % of gene width can have novel mutations

summ.table$max.p.mut<-max.p.mut
summ.table$max.muts<-NA_integer_
summ.table$Ntip.pendant.out<-NA_integer_

# store per-segment pendant outliers
pend_outlier_list<-vector("list", length = l.tre)

for (i in 1:l.tre){
  segment<-resid[[i]]$segment[1]
  pendants<-pendant.edge(trees[[i]])
  gene.width<-summ.table$width[i] #have to divide by width to get subs/site
  max.muts<-max.p.mut*gene.width
  pend.cutoff<-max.muts/gene.width

  # align pendant edges to resid seq_new (some may be NA)
  pend.var<-pendants[match(resid[[i]]$seq_new, pendants$species),]
  out_idx<-which(!is.na(pend.var$w) & (pend.var$w > pend.cutoff))
  n.cutoff<-length(out_idx)

  #add to the summary table
  summ.table$Ntip.pendant.out[i]<-n.cutoff
  summ.table$max.muts[i]<-max.muts
  
  #density plot of # mutations on pend edges for this subvar
  min.x<-max(pend.var$w, na.rm=T)
  max.y<-.95
  
  ggplot(pend.var)+
    geom_density(aes(x=round(w*gene.width), y=..scaled..))+
    labs(x="Number of mutations on pendant edge",y="Scaled density")+
    theme_bw()+
    geom_vline(xintercept=max.muts,color="red",linetype=2)+
    annotate("text",label=paste("cutoff = ",max.muts,"\n", "n excluded = ",n.cutoff,sep=""),
             x=max.muts, y=0.95, hjust=0,color="black",size=3)+
    ggtitle(segment)
  ggsave(paste(fig.out,"/PendantEdges_N-outliers_",segment,".png",sep=""), height=3, width=4,units="in")

  # record outliers for this segment (as a long table)
  if (n.cutoff > 0) {
    pend_outlier_list[[i]]<-data.frame(
      segment = rep(segment,length(out_idx)),
      seq_new = pend.var$species[out_idx],
      pendant_muts = round(pend.var$w[out_idx] * gene.width),
      pendant_rate = pend.var$w[out_idx],
      pend_cutoff_rate = rep(pend.cutoff,length(out_idx)) )
    cat(paste0("\nSegment ", segment,
        " pendant-edge outliers flagged (segment-specific, >",
        max.muts, " muts): ",
        paste(pend.var$species[out_idx], collapse = ", ")  ),
      file = text.out, sep = "\n", append = TRUE)
  } else { pend_outlier_list[[i]]<-data.frame(
      segment = character(0),
      seq_new = character(0),
      pendant_muts = integer(0),
      pendant_rate = numeric(0),
      pend_cutoff_rate = numeric(0),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

    cat(paste0("\nSegment ", segment, " pendant-edge outliers flagged: none (cutoff=", max.muts, " muts)"),
      file = text.out, sep = "\n", append = TRUE)
  }
}

pend_outlier_tbl<-dplyr::bind_rows(pend_outlier_list)

#segment-level removal set
bad.seqs.seg.pend<-pend_outlier_tbl %>%
  distinct(seq_new) %>%
  pull(seq_new)

bad.samps.pend<-resid.all %>% 
  filter(seq_new %in% bad.seqs.seg.pend) %>% 
  distinct (sample) %>% 
  pull(sample) #4 bad samples, 29 bad seqs within them

#sample-level removal set
bad.seqs.pend<-resid.all %>% 
  filter(sample %in% bad.samps.pend) %>% 
  pull(seq_new)
length(bad.seqs.pend) 

#join the sample on to this
pend_outlier_tbl<-pend_outlier_tbl %>% left_join (resid.all, by="seq_new")

# Log the UNION list
write.csv(pend_outlier_tbl, paste0(f.out2, "pend_outlier_tbl.csv"))

#apply removal to tree and resid
for (i in 1:l.tre) {
  # only drop tips that are present in that segment tree
  if (length(bad.seqs.pend) > 0) {
    tips_present<-intersect(trees[[i]]$tip.label, bad.seqs.pend)
    if (length(tips_present) > 0) {
      trees[[i]]<-ape::drop.tip(phy = trees[[i]], 
                                  tip = tips_present)
    }
  }
  # filter residual df (if any)
  resid[[i]]<-resid[[i]] %>% 
    dplyr::filter(!seq_new %in% bad.seqs.pend)
}

```

## Root-to-tip regression after removing outliers
```{r}
#pull model fits into summary table
summ.table$modelfit.end<-NA
summ.table$R2.end<-NA
summ.table$slope.end<-NA

for (i in 1:l.tre){
  segment<-resid[[i]]$segment[1]

  #root-to-tip regression
  lm<-summary(lm(resid[[i]]$distance ~ resid[[i]]$date))
  resid[[i]]$residual<-residuals(lm(resid[[i]]$distance ~ resid[[i]]$date))
  slope<-formatC(coef(lm)[[2]],format="e", digits=2)
  slope.n<-coef(lm)[[2]] #numeric
  int<-coef(lm)[[1]]
  eq<-paste("y = ",slope," x + ",signif(int,digits=3),sep="")
  R2<-signif(lm$adj.r.squared,digits = 3)
  
  #set positions
  min.x<-min(resid[[i]]$date)
  max.y<-max(resid[[i]]$distance)

  #overlay line on scatter plot, colored by residual
  ggplot(resid[[i]])+
    geom_point(aes(x=date,y=distance, color=abs(residual)))+
    scale_color_continuous(type = "viridis")+
    labs(x="Year",y="Root-to-tip distance",color="Abs.value\nresidual",title=segment)+
    theme_bw()+
    geom_abline(slope=slope.n,intercept = int,color="black")+
    annotate("text",label=paste("Adj.R^2=",R2,"\n",eq,sep=""),x=min.x,y=max.y*0.98,vjust=1,hjust=0,color="black",size=3)
  ggsave(paste(fig.out,"/TemporalSignalResidExclOutliers_",segment,".png",sep=""),height=3,width=4,units="in")
  
  #Add to summary table
  summ.table$modelfit.end[i]<-eq
  summ.table$R2.end[i]<-R2
  summ.table$slope.end[i]<-slope.n
  summ.table$ntip.final[i]<-nrow(resid[[i]])
}

#EXPORT SUMMARY TABLE
write.csv(summ.table, summ.table.out, row.names=F)
```

## exclude outliers from alignment
```{r}
for(i in 1:l.tre){
  #only keep the keepers
  keep<-which(names(nuc[[i]])%in% trees[[i]]$tip.label)
  nuc[[i]]<-nuc[[i]][keep]
  # print(length(nuc[[i]])==Ntip(trees[[i]]))
  ## naming order is the same in fasta and tree (for lsd2)
  if(!all(names(nuc[[i]])==trees[[i]]$tip.label)){
    #reorder the fasta to match tree
    nuc[[i]]<-nuc[[i]][order(match(names(nuc[[i]]),
                                   trees[[i]]$tip.label))]
  }
}
```
